reforms.description: The federal government announced the establishment of an Industrial Opportunities Program to coordinate support for industrial restructuring, innovation, and all phases of product development.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Supports industrial innovation and product development, which can enhance productivity and competitiveness in manufacturing sectors.
reforms.status_evidence: An Industrial Opportunities Program is being created to co-ordinate support for industrial restructuring, innovation and all phases of product development.
reforms.importance_rationale: Represents a significant institutional coordination mechanism for innovation support across industrial sectors, though implementation details and budget allocation are not specified in the text.
reforms.source_quote: An Industrial Opportunities Program is being created to co-ordinate support for industrial restructuring, innovation and all phases of product development.
